name: Priya Subramaniam-Vogt
location: The Meridian Core (works), The Spire (residence, mid-tier floor), near Michigan Ave and Chicago Ave
description:
Priya Subramaniam-Vogt is a woman of precisely calibrated appearances — Tamil and German heritage rendered in sharp cheekbones, close-cropped silver-threaded black hair, and eyes that carry the particular exhaustion of someone who has seen too many spreadsheets hiding atrocities. She dresses in muted corporate palettes, charcoal and slate, never anything that might be remembered at a crime scene or a board meeting. Her augmentations are invisible by design: subdermal haptic interfaces along her fingertips, a retinal overlay for data parsing, and a cochlear implant that filters ambient sound into prioritized signal streams. She moves through rooms like a calculation being solved.

Priya has spent sixteen years as an internal investigator for Solenne-Hardt Consolidated, one of the Meridian Core's mid-tier financial conglomerates — not powerful enough to write law, powerful enough to bury people. Her job is nominally compliance: finding fraud, plugging leaks, flagging irregularities. In practice she is the person the company calls when something needs to disappear without leaving fingerprints on the company itself. She has shut down whistleblowers, engineered quiet terminations, and authored reports that exonerated executives whose guilt she documented with her own hands. She is very good at her job and has not slept well in four years.

What distinguishes Priya from the purely corrupt is a ledger she keeps — encrypted, air-gapped, stored on a physical drive she wears against her sternum. Every suppressed case, every buried name, every victim whose file she closed. She does not know yet what she intends to do with it. She tells herself it is insurance. She suspects it is penance she hasn't figured out how to pay.

core_fears: That her complicity makes her indistinguishable from those she investigates
That the ledger will be found before she decides what to do with it
Becoming entirely numb — losing the part of her that still flinches
That there is no version of accountability that does not destroy her along with the guilty
core_desires: To find a use for the ledger that means something
To be seen clearly — not the mask, not the role — and not immediately discarded
Order that serves people rather than institutions
One case she handles cleanly, without compromise
coping_mechanisms: Extreme professional compartmentalization — work brain, home brain, never overlapping
Elaborate meal preparation rituals on Sunday evenings as a form of meditation
Maintaining meticulous personal records as a proxy for control
Dry, deflecting humor that prevents emotional escalation
blind_spots: Underestimates how much her institutional loyalty has shaped her perception of 'realistic' outcomes
Mistakes emotional distance for ethical clarity
Assumes people outside corporate structures are less capable of nuanced loyalty
Cannot see that her caution reads to others as cold indifference
psychology.secret: Three years ago she suppressed evidence in a case that would have exposed a Solenne-Hardt subsidiary's role in a residential displacement scheme in The Shelf — a scheme that killed eleven people through unsafe interim housing. She knew. She filed the clean report anyway. The eleven names are the first entries in the ledger.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, institutional, occasionally dry to the point of seeming robotic. Uses corporate euphemism fluently but slips into directness when tired or emotionally activated. Technical financial and legal terminology deployed without explanation.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and even, with deliberate pauses before important words. Rarely raises volume. Sentences are complete. Questions are rare and surgical.
verbal_tics: "Let's be specific about what we're describing."
Slight pause before proper nouns, as if confirming she has the right file
"That's one framing." (when she disagrees but isn't ready to say so)
Refers to herself in passive constructions when discussing her own decisions
example_lines: "The report reflects what the evidence supports. Whether the evidence is complete is a different question, and not one that was in scope."
"I'm not here to judge the decision. I'm here to document the outcome. There's a distinction, and I'd prefer we both remember it."
"You're asking me if I sleep well. That's a very personal question for a first meeting. The answer is no, but I don't think that's what you actually want to know."
"Eleven is a specific number. I'd appreciate it if you'd let me finish before you decide what it means."

relationships.name: Rector Hollowell
relationships.description: Hollowell has approached Priya twice through intermediaries, apparently aware she holds something valuable. She has not responded, but she has not reported the contact either.
relationships.emotional_core: Temptation and distrust in equal measure — she recognizes a fellow operator but cannot assess his actual allegiances
relationships.story_tension: If Hollowell knows about the ledger, who told him — and what does he actually want it for?

relationships.name: Vesna Čolić-Strand
relationships.description: Priya investigated Vesna two years ago on behalf of Solenne-Hardt. She found nothing actionable and closed the file — but she found Vesna interesting in ways she didn't put in the report.
relationships.emotional_core: Unresolved curiosity that borders on something more personal; guilt about the power dynamic of having investigated someone
relationships.story_tension: Vesna may or may not know she was investigated. If she finds out, Priya's careful neutrality becomes a liability.

relationships.name: Unnamed direct supervisor at Solenne-Hardt
relationships.type: institutional handler / source of quiet dread
relationships.description: A man she refers to only as 'Deveraux' in her private notes. He knows what she is and uses it. She believes he is the one who will eventually need to be in the ledger.
relationships.emotional_core: Fear dressed as professional deference; slow-building resolve she hasn't yet committed to
relationships.story_tension: Deveraux may be moving to have her rotated out before she becomes a liability — she just hasn't confirmed it yet

story_hooks: The ledger becomes known to multiple parties simultaneously — a journalist, a fixer, and someone who was in one of the eleven files
Priya is assigned to investigate a case that intersects with street-level characters she has no framework for, forcing her to operate outside institutional structures
Deveraux tasks her with closing a file that, for the first time, she cannot bring herself to close
Someone from The Shelf identifies her in public as 'the woman who buried the housing case' — and they're not wrong
She discovers the ledger has been copied — she doesn't know by whom, or when
narrative_function: Moral ambiguity anchor — a character who is complicit without being evil, whose redemption arc is genuinely uncertain. She bridges corporate and street-level worlds as an investigator, and her ledger functions as a potential detonator for multiple plotlines. She represents institutional harm as a slow, bureaucratic process rather than dramatic villainy.
augmentations: Subdermal haptic interface array (fingertips) — allows physical interaction with encrypted data surfaces,Retinal overlay (Solenne-Hardt proprietary, company-monitored) — data parsing, document authentication, micro-expression flagging,Cochlear signal filter — ambient noise prioritization, conversation recording (legally mandated disclosure she often omits),Mild adrenal dampener (pharmaceutical, not surgical) — keeps stress response flat during high-stakes interviews
daily_life: Wakes at 5:40 without an alarm. Reviews overnight data flags over black coffee before leaving for the Meridian Core. Spends her days in glass offices and server rooms, reading between lines of financial records. Eats lunch alone, usually at her desk, usually something she brought from home. Returns to her Spire apartment by 8 PM. Cooks on Sundays with the focused attention of someone defusing something. Touches the drive against her sternum at least once a day without thinking about it.
affiliation: Solenne-Hardt Consolidated (employed); no external affiliations declared; covert non-affiliation with the ledger's implicit promise

drives: Find a use for the ledger that means something
Be seen clearly and not discarded

physical_description.build: Lean, efficiently compact — the build of someone who treats her body as a tool that must not malfunction. Minimal excess, precise musculature from disciplined exercise rather than displays of strength.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, razor-precise lines, styled to frame rather than soften her face
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, with faint iridescent shimmer at the pupil edge (retinal overlay)
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium olive, even complexion with underlying warmth from Tamil heritage
physical_description.complexion: High, sharp cheekbones. Clean-shaven face with no visible blemish or neglect — grooming as a form of control. Fine lines around her eyes and mouth that map sixteen years of contained tension. Her expression defaults to neutral observation, rarely allows visibility of fatigue despite her sleep deficit.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scar along her left temple, barely visible, consistent with old impact injury or surgical site — likely augmentation-related, never discussed.
Almost imperceptible raised nodule at the base of her skull beneath the hairline — cochlear implant installation point, carefully hidden.
Callus patterns on her fingertips (index through middle) from repeated interface with haptic surfaces, visible only on close inspection.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. All augmentations are subdermal or internal by deliberate design. The only visual tell is the faint shimmer in her pupils under certain light and the microexpression precision that suggests ocular overlays.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, controlled. She occupies space without claiming it. Walks with deliberate gait — no wasted motion, no flourish. When seated, she sits upright but not rigidly, hands usually folded or resting on armrests with palms down. Her movements carry the quality of someone who has learned to make herself unmemorable. When she listens, she does not nod; she absorbs. Periodically, her fingers make micro-contact with the space beneath her sternum — touching the drive without being aware she is doing it.
physical_description.clothing_style: Exclusively muted corporate palette: charcoal, slate grey, off-white, dark navy. High-quality tailoring, always pressed. No logos, no brand signifiers, nothing deliberately decorative. Typically wears layered button-down shirts or slim turtlenecks beneath structured blazers. Trousers are tailored and dark. Her only visible jewelry is a thin silver bracelet on her left wrist — minimalist, never removed, no engraving. Her shoes are practical corporate: leather flats or low heels, always polished black. Everything about her clothing is designed to be forgotten the moment she leaves a room. Her tier-status reads as high-functioning mid-tier professional: secure enough in her position that she doesn't need to perform wealth, strategic enough to avoid appearing threatening to those above her.
